"prelude.fx: what KFX has that FX-26's standard environment has only at
 `int`. KFX has no `int` (PLAN.md, section 2): it writes `i64`, whose
 arithmetic wraps in FX-26 as in Rust.

 This file is FX-26, not KFX: it is where `int` meets `i64`. Fixpt reads
 it before a KFX program (stage 0). The transpiler never sees it: each
 name here is a function of kayak-rt, by the same mangling, and this file
 is that function's meaning." : string ! pure

"Flat arrays of i64s (FX-26's flatarrayof), their sizes and indices at\n i64. In Rust, a slice of Cells: FX-26's flat arrays may be aliased, and\n written through any alias, as a Cell may." : string ! pure
make-flatarray-i64 : (poly ((r region)) (subr (alloc r) (i64 i64) (flatarrayof i64 r))) ! pure
flatarray-ref-i64 : (poly ((r region)) (subr (read r) ((flatarrayof i64 r) i64) i64)) ! pure
flatarray-set-i64! : (poly ((r region)) (subr (write r) ((flatarrayof i64 r) i64 i64) unit)) ! pure
flatarray-length-i64 : (poly ((r region)) (subr pure ((flatarrayof i64 r)) i64)) ! pure

"A suspension (CLAUDES_CHOICES.md C45, docs/research/async-rust.md): the
 rest of the computation up to `tag`'s prompt, `k`, given to `f`, and an
 abort there with `f k`. FX-26 would let `k` be resumed again and again;
 KFX's, a Rust future, once: so here a second resume fails, as in Rust.
 Its value is what `k` is resumed with." : string ! pure

abort-with-continuation : (poly ((v type) (a type) (h type) (d effect) (r region) (e effect)) (subr (maxeff (alloc r) (goto r) (comefrom r) e) ((prompt-tag a h d r) (subr e ((subr (maxeff (read r) (write r) (goto r) (comefrom r) d) (v) a)) h)) v)) ! pure

"A prompt around a call of a module's procedure that escapes to a tag at
 the same region: the procedure may reach another tag there, so the
 prompt does not remove the `goto` (C116; KFX had looked at the module's
 name, whose type mentions no region, and removed it)." : string ! pure
m : (moduleof (val positive (subr (maxeff (goto @z) spin) ((escape-tag string string @z) int) int))) ! pure
